label: Auto-Tagged Link
description: A single URL as the whole frame -- no browser, no chrome, oversized monospace. The SHORT link types itself character by character in ink with a blinking caret (the part a human wrote); then the caret vanishes and the UTM parameters APPEAR one at a time in the brand accent with a flash, never typed. The two colors carry the argument: dark is yours, accent is automatic. Cast it for auto-tagging / attribution beats where the claim is 'you never wrote these tags' -- it is a type detail-cut, not a product mock, so it needs no window and fills the frame on its own.

base.label: The short link a human would type (ink colored, types character by character). Default 'getquotient.link/q3-launch'

params.label: Query segments that append THEMSELVES, in order, each in accent color with a flash -- include the leading ? and & (e.g. ["?utm_source=linkedin", "&utm_campaign=q3_launch", "&utm_medium=social"])

type_at.label: When the base link starts typing (seconds, default 0.2)

type_duration.label: How long the base link takes to type (seconds, default 1.0)

param_interval.label: Seconds between appended segments (default 0.7). Ignored when param_times is set.

param_times.label: Explicit seconds for each appended segment (overrides param_interval -- use it to land tags on the beat grid)

font_size.label: CSS size for the link (default '56px'). A ~90-character tagged URL wraps to two lines at this size on a 1920 canvas.

ink.label: Color of the human-typed base link (default '#17171c')

accent.label: Color of the auto-appended parameters and the caret (default '#393bf5')
